units: pixels at pixelsPerUnit from the feet hotspot, x right and y down; rightHandAngle and leftHandAngle in degrees, the forearm (elbow to hand) rotated from straight down the picture, positive towards the right; visible bit 0 = the kid's right hand is seen, bit 1 = the left hand; headYaw and headPitch in degrees per frame; directions 5 to 7 mirror 3 to 1 with every x negated and every angle negated
headTop: the top of the skull, where a hat's hotspot goes; headX and headY is the head centre, where the earmuffs' hotspot goes; the hands' points are the rig's hand end points, where a mitten's hotspot goes
